translations.u067: Commission Sale, in which Fleequid, under an irrevocable mandate from the Users, arranges on their behalf the sale and purchase of the Vehicle, performing the transaction, alternatively, by means of Resale or acting as a Pure Intermediary;
translations.u068: Dealer Sales, in which Fleequid purchases the Vehicle from the Seller in its own name and on its own behalf and resells it, again in its own name and on its own behalf, to the Buyer.

The Resale and operation as a Pure Intermediary constitute alternative methods of performance of the Commission Sale and not separate Sales Models.
translations.u070: Where the specific transaction is classified as a Commission Sale pursuant to Art. 3, Users acknowledge and accept that the relevant Sales Event is organised and managed by Fleequid under an irrevocable mandate from the Users and on their behalf. In such cases, and with reference to the specific transaction, the User who operates on the Marketplace as a Seller, having submitted an Offer to Sell to Fleequid, grants Fleequid, which accepts, the irrevocable mandate to sell on that User's behalf the Vehicles indicated from time to time, at the Sale Price to the Buyer, determined, as the case may be, as corresponding to: a. the value of the Highest Bid when it is equal to or higher than the Reserve Price, always previously determined on the basis of the MCSP indicated by the Seller; b. the Highest Bid lower than such RP, but expressly accepted by the Seller pursuant to Art. 10.3; c. the value of the counter-offer made by the Seller to the Bidder and accepted by the latter; or d. the price resulting from the further Sales Event methods provided for in Art. 9.4. The classification of the mandate provided for in this paragraph as a commission mandate pursuant to Art. 1731 of the Italian Civil Code, with Fleequid consequently acting in its own name, applies exclusively where the transaction is performed by means of Resale pursuant to Art. 2.5 below; where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary, the sale is concluded directly between the Seller and the Buyer pursuant to Art. 2.6 below. The Offer to Sell does not, in itself, entail the granting of a commission mandate pursuant to Art. 1731 of the Italian Civil Code, which arises exclusively in cases where Fleequid acts as a commission agent in the specific transaction.
translations.u071: Where Fleequid performs the Commission Sale by means of Resale, Users acknowledge and accept that Fleequid acts in its own name and on behalf of the Users, as a commission agent for both the Bidder and the Seller, with an irrevocable mandate to buy and to sell, respectively, pursuant to Arts. 1703 et seq. and 1731 of the Italian Civil Code, and is entitled to the Commissions due from both on the terms provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. translations.u072: In the context of the Commission Sale, Fleequid may, at its sole discretion, decide not to carry out the Resale and to perform the commissioned sale as a Pure Intermediary, allowing the transfer of the Vehicle and the related invoicing to take place directly from the Seller to the Buyer. Operation as a Pure Intermediary constitutes an internal method of performance of the Commission Sale pursuant to Art. 2.3 and not a separate Sales Model. translations.u073: In the Dealer Sales Model, Fleequid purchases the Vehicle from the Seller in its own name and on its own behalf and resells it to the Buyer, again in its own name and on its own behalf, taking on the role of substantial party to both contracts, as buyer in the first and as seller in the second, respectively. translations.u157: Unless otherwise provided in these GTC or in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions, the Auctions organised by Fleequid have a Reserve Price. translations.u158: Unless expressly indicated otherwise, all amounts listed on the Marketplace, in the Listing or otherwise in the communications relating to the specific transaction are expressed in EUR and are net of VAT, if applicable, as well as of any further tax, administrative or statutory charges payable by the User under the applicable legislation or the conditions of the specific transaction.

translations.u162: The Binding Agreement is concluded: a) in Auctions with a Reserve Price, at the close of the Sales Event, when the Highest Bid is equal to or higher than the Reserve Price; b) in Auctions without a Reserve Price, at the close of the Sales Event, in favour of the Bidder who has submitted the Highest Bid, in accordance with the conditions applicable to the specific type of Auction; c) where the Highest Bid is lower than the Reserve Price, upon acceptance of the Bid or of the subsequent counter-offer in accordance with Art. 10.3; d) in the Buy Now method, upon submission of the Bid corresponding to the price and conditions indicated for that method; e) in the Private Sale, at the moment determined by the conditions laid down for the specific Sales Event, by means of the submission or acceptance of a Bid conforming to the price and conditions made known to the Bidder; f) in the Negotiation and in the Off-Auction Sale, upon acceptance of the Bid or of the counter-offer in accordance with Art. 9.4, letters e) and f). translations.u171: In the cases provided for in letters a) and b) above, the new Binding Agreement is concluded upon Fleequid's notification to the Bidder concerned of the acceptance of the relevant Bid, subject to any consent of the Seller where required in the Commission Sale, or on the basis of Fleequid's own decision in Dealer Sales, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 10.4 on the verification of requirements. translations.u185: The Buyer shall pay the Total Amount Due in full within the Payment Period provided for in Art. 11, by bank transfer to the bank details indicated in the Proforma, unless a different payment method is expressly provided for the specific transaction. translations.u186: Full performance of the Buyer's payment obligation, by means of actual receipt of all the sums included in the Total Amount Due by the respective recipients, gives rise to the commencement of the performance phase of the transaction depending on the applicable Sales Model and the chosen method of performance. translations.u187: Following full performance of the payment obligation pursuant to Art. 12.2 the Vehicle acquires the status of sold and the performance phase of the transaction is carried out depending on the applicable Sales Model and the chosen method of performance, including, where provided for, the formalities of invoicing, transfer of ownership, registration, delivery and collection of the Vehicle governed by Art. 16 and by the further applicable provisions. translations.u189: Where the Buyer makes the payment by means of multiple payments not previously authorised by Fleequid, but completes payment in full of the Total Amount Due within the Payment Period, it shall pay Fleequid, by way of penalty, the amount of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each Vehicle concerned, without prejudice to compensation for any further damage. The breach provided for in this paragraph is independent of and distinct from delay in payment; the relevant penalty is not taken into account in determining the penalty component relevant for the purposes of the minimum threshold referred to in the last sentence of Art. 12.9.
translations.u190: Once the Payment Period has expired without the Buyer having performed in full the obligation to pay the Total Amount Due: a) the Buyer is in delay and incurs, by way of penalty, the amount of €150.00 (EUR one hundred and fifty/00) for each day of delay, starting from the first day following the expiry of the Payment Period, without the need for formal notice of default and up to a maximum aggregate amount of €5,000.00 (EUR five thousand/00) for each Vehicle; b) default interest pursuant to Legislative Decree 231/2002 is also due; c) the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status and may not be the subject of new Bids, without prejudice to the provisions of Art. 10.5 with regard to the Bids already submitted and still effective; d) the Seller remains bound by the sale and by the obligations provided for in Arts. 8.9, 8.12 and 11.3 for as long as the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status; e) Fleequid retains the right to receive and accept late payment, without prejudice to the provisions on penalties, interest and further sums due for the delay; the receipt or acceptance of late payment does not, in itself, entail a waiver of the penalties, interest or other amounts already accrued, save for an express written waiver by Fleequid notified through one of the official channels; f) Fleequid may adopt the measures provided for in Art. 12.10.
translations.u191: A period of 7 (seven) days, running from the Proforma being made available pursuant to Art. 11.4, remains applicable, within which Fleequid retains the right to receive late payment under the conditions provided for in Art. 12.6. The aforesaid period includes the ordinary Payment Period of 3 (three) days referred to in Art. 11.5 and does not constitute a further period running from its expiry. Once such period has expired without the Buyer having performed in full, Fleequid may, at its discretion and without the need for any further formal demand or notice of default: a) nevertheless accept late payment, the Commissions payable by the Buyer, the penalties, the interest, the Fees and the further amounts accrued remaining due, save for an express written waiver by Fleequid; or b) proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale on account of the Buyer's breach. The Parties expressly agree that the failure to pay the Total Amount Due in full within the period provided for in this paragraph constitutes a breach which is not of minor importance and entitles Fleequid to declare the Contract terminated pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code, by means of a written notice in which it declares that it intends to rely on this express termination clause; the Cancellation of the Sale ordered pursuant to letter b) constitutes the exercise of that right and produces its effects, in accordance with Art. 14.1. The Cancellation of the Sale is ordered by means of a unilateral declaration by Fleequid notified in writing to the Buyer and to the Seller through the channels provided for in Art. 24 and takes effect from the moment of notification. Until that moment the Contract is not automatically dissolved, the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status and the Seller remains bound as provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. The mere expiry of the period of 7 (seven) days does not prevent Fleequid from subsequently accepting late payment, for as long as the Cancellation of the Sale has not been notified. Until full payment or, if earlier, until the Cancellation of the Sale takes effect, default interest and the further amounts due as a consequence of the delay continue to accrue; the daily penalty referred to in Art. 12.6, letter a), continues to accrue only until the maximum aggregate amount provided for therein is reached. The reaching of such maximum amount results exclusively in the cessation of the accrual of further amounts by way of daily penalty and does not affect the Commissions, the Fees, the default interest, the further amounts due or the consequences of the Cancellation of the Sale provided for in these General Terms and Conditions.
translations.u192: Following the Cancellation of the Sale on account of the Buyer's breach: a) the Optioned Status of the Vehicle ceases vis-à-vis the defaulting Buyer and Fleequid may proceed in accordance with Art. 10.5 vis-à-vis the other Bidders whose Bids are still valid and binding; b) where Fleequid does not avail itself of one of the Bids still effective pursuant to Art. 10.5, or where there are none, the Vehicle may be marketed again by Fleequid by means of a new Sales Event, including under a different Sales Model, in compliance with Arts. 3, 8.6 and 8.8 and with the financial terms applicable in the relationship with the Seller; c) the Seller ceases to be obliged to keep the Vehicle reserved for the defaulting Buyer, without prejudice to the marketing and sale commitment undertaken pursuant to Art. 8.8 and to the further obligations provided for in these General Terms and Conditions; d) the daily penalty provided for in Art. 12.6, letter a), ceases to accrue on the date on which the Cancellation takes effect, the amounts accrued up to that moment remaining definitively due, together with the default interest accrued; e) the amounts provided for in Art. 12.9 remain due from the Buyer; the Commissions payable by the Seller for the cancelled transaction, on the other hand, do not accrue, pursuant to Art. 12.4; f) any Security Deposit provided by the Buyer may be retained and applied to the sums due in accordance with Art. 6.3, with any excess being returned within the time limits provided for therein; g) the Cancellation produces the effects provided for in Art. 6 on User Classification, where the relevant conditions are met, and allows the adoption of the measures provided for in Art. 12.10; h) Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage remains unaffected; i) the defaulting Buyer may not assert any right or claim over the Vehicle, over its subsequent sale to another Bidder or to a third party, over the price of the subsequent transaction or over any difference, positive or negative, compared with the price of the cancelled sale. The common restitutionary and financial effects are governed by Art. 15.
translations.u193: In the event of Cancellation of the Sale on account of delay or failure to make full payment attributable to the Buyer, the following remain definitively due to Fleequid: a) the Commissions payable by the Buyer, where provided for the specific transaction, as established in Art. 12.4; b) the daily penalty referred to in Art. 12.6, letter a), accrued up to the date on which the Cancellation of the Sale takes effect, as well as the default interest accrued; c) in the Commission Sale, both where Fleequid operates by means of Resale and where it acts as a Pure Intermediary, a further penalty in an amount equal to twice the Commissions payable by the Buyer, determined on the basis of the Commissions applicable to the specific transaction, so that the aggregate amount due in respect of Commissions and of this penalty is equal to three times the amount of the Commissions; d) a further penalty of €1,000.00 (EUR one thousand/00) for each Vehicle covered by the Binding Agreement subsequently cancelled; e) the Fees relating to the Services already rendered and any other amount accrued on a separate basis pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions. In Dealer Sales, since no Commissions under the Commission Sale are due from the Buyer, the penalty referred to in letter c) does not apply; the amounts referred to in letters b), d) and e), on the other hand, remain due. Where the conditions provided for in Art. 13 are met, the conversion of the Advance Payment into a penalty pursuant to Art. 13.6 also remains unaffected. The sums provided for in this paragraph are due on separate bases and may be cumulated within the limits permitted by law. Any Security Deposit provided constitutes exclusively security for the Buyer's obligations and may be applied to the sums due in accordance with Art. 6.3, without constituting a further basis for any charge. Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage remains unaffected, limited to the part exceeding what has already been satisfied by means of the penalties provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. Where the sum of the penalties referred to in letters b), limited to the daily penalty, c) and d) and, where applicable, of the penalty resulting from the conversion of the Advance Payment pursuant to Art. 13.6 is lower than 5% of the Sale Price to the Buyer of the Vehicle that is the subject of the cancelled sale, the penalty component due in total is supplemented exclusively up to that threshold, which operates as a financial floor and not as a further cumulative sanction. For the purposes of the comparison and of the supplement provided for in the preceding sentence: (i) the basis of calculation consists exclusively of the Sale Price to the Buyer of the Vehicle that is the subject of the cancelled sale, excluding the Total Amount Due, the Commissions, the Fees and any other ancillary amount; (ii) only the penalties specific to the Buyer's breach indicated above are relevant; (iii) the Commissions payable by the Buyer, the Fees, the default interest, the Security Deposit retained or applied, the reimbursements of costs and expenses and the compensation for further damage are not relevant. This provision applies to all Sales Models; in Dealer Sales the comparison is made solely with the penalties applicable therein, and the penalty referred to in letter c) may be neither introduced nor taken into account.
translations.u194: From the occurrence of the delay or non-payment, and for its entire duration, Fleequid may at its discretion restrict or suspend the operation of the Buyer's profile, including by preventing the submission of new Bids or access to certain Sales Events. Where Fleequid accepts late payment, it may restore the operation of the profile, where appropriate maintaining a different deposit regime or a different User Classification pursuant to Art. 6. In the event of Cancellation of the Sale on account of non-payment, Fleequid may maintain or tighten the restriction, up to and including the blocking of the Buyer's profile. The measures provided for in this paragraph, the User Classification and the consequent deposit regime referred to in Art. 6, as well as the Cancellation of the Sale, are separate mechanisms that may be applied cumulatively. The restriction or suspension of the operation of the profile does not dissolve the Binding Agreement, does not affect its effectiveness and does not release the Buyer from the obligations already undertaken, including the obligation to pay the Total Amount Due and the further amounts due pursuant to this article. The measures provided for in this paragraph are independent of the measures that may be adopted pursuant to Arts. 5.6 and 5.7 and are not subject to the conditions and time limits provided for therein.
translations.u195: The Seller acknowledges and accepts that, in the cases provided for in this article, Fleequid may proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale on account of delay or non-payment attributable to the Buyer, without this constituting a breach by Fleequid vis-à-vis the Seller. In such cases the Seller waives the right to bring against Fleequid any claims for damages, restitution or of any other nature based on the Cancellation of the Sale or on the failure to complete the relevant performance phase, without prejudice to the Seller's right solely to any sums already accrued on a different basis pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions. The provisions of Arts. 8.8 and 10.5 also remain unaffected as regards the continuation of the Seller's commitment, the use of the further Bids still effective and the subsequent marketing of the Vehicle.
translations.u197: In transactions in which it is expressly agreed that, after the conclusion of the Binding Agreement, the Vehicle shall temporarily remain in use by the Seller, Fleequid may require the Buyer to pay in advance an amount equal to 30% of the Total Amount Due (the “Advance Payment”). The arrangement governed by this article is referred to, for descriptive and commercial purposes only, as a “Deferred Sale”. The Deferred Sale does not constitute a separate Sales Model and remains subject in its entirety to the Sales Model applicable to the specific transaction and, in the context of the Commission Sale, to the relevant method of performance. The Deferred Sale may be agreed exclusively in the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale and in Dealer Sales and does not apply where Fleequid acts as a Pure Intermediary; in Commission Sale transactions to which this article applies, Fleequid therefore performs the transaction by means of Resale. The fact that the Vehicle temporarily remains in use by the Seller, together with the special conditions applicable to the transaction, must be made known to the Bidder before the Bid is placed, in accordance with Arts. 3.2 and 4.5. Where requested, the Advance Payment must be paid within the ordinary Payment Period referred to in Art. 11.5, running from the date on which the Proforma is made available, unless the Special Sale Terms and Conditions expressly provide for a different period pursuant to Art. 11.6, letter b). These rules apply exclusively to such arrangement and constitute a derogation from the ordinary rules on the Payment Period within the limits provided for in this article and in the applicable Special Sale Terms and Conditions.
translations.u198: The Advance Payment is made on account of the price and is applied to the Total Amount Due where the transaction is duly completed. The Advance Payment constitutes neither a confirmatory deposit nor a withdrawal deposit, and Arts. 1385 and 1386 of the Italian Civil Code do not apply.
translations.u199: The balance of the Total Amount Due, less the Advance Payment already paid, must be paid by the different due date established for the specific transaction and made known to the Buyer in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions. Until the balance has been paid in full, the Vehicle remains in Optioned Status and the Seller remains bound by the sale and by the obligations provided for in Arts. 8.8, 8.12 and 11.3, subject to the derogations referred to in Art. 13.4. Payment of the Advance Payment does not, in itself, result in the commencement of the performance phase of the sale or, in the case of Auctions, in the Final Award, which follow only from full performance of the payment obligation in accordance with Art. 12.2.
translations.u200: The Seller may continue to use the Vehicle only within the limits and on the conditions agreed for the specific transaction, in derogation from the general obligation to keep it unused and available for sale provided for in Art. 8.12. During that period the Seller is, in particular, required to: a) keep the Vehicle available for subsequent delivery; b) refrain from selling it, promising it to third parties, creating Encumbrances over it or otherwise making it unavailable; c) keep the Vehicle in its custody with due care, maintain it in efficient working order and preserve, in so far as compatible with the authorised use, its condition and characteristics as resulting from the Technical Specifications; d) not exceed any mileage limit agreed; e) notify Fleequid without delay of any accident, failure, deterioration, damage or other event capable of affecting the condition, value, availability or marketability of the Vehicle; f) comply with the date agreed for the cessation of use and for making the Vehicle available or releasing it. The Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the specific transaction shall indicate at least: the date on which the Vehicle is to be released or made available; the maximum additional mileage permitted; the due date for payment of the balance; the consequences of exceeding the mileage limit, of deterioration and of delay in making the Vehicle available or releasing it. The financial consequences arising from exceeding the limits on use, mileage or duration or from the other conditions laid down for the temporary use of the Vehicle by the Seller, including any penalties, indemnities, adjustments or tolerances, are determined in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the specific transaction.
translations.u201: Failure to pay the Advance Payment within the relevant period, or failure to pay the balance in full by the due date established for the specific transaction, constitutes delay on the part of the Buyer. From the first day following the respective due date, the provisions of Art. 12.6 shall apply, in so far as compatible, including the penalty of €150.00 for each day of delay and for each Vehicle concerned, up to the maximum aggregate amount provided for in Art. 12.6, letter a), which operates as a single cap for each Vehicle and for the same transaction with reference both to delay in paying the Advance Payment and to delay in paying the balance, as well as the interest and the further amounts provided for therein. In the event of failure to pay the Advance Payment, the time limits and rights provided for in Art. 12.7 shall apply. In the event of failure to pay the balance, in place of the maximum time limit provided for in Art. 12.7, Fleequid retains the right to receive late payment for the 4 (four) days following the due date established for payment of the balance, without a new period of 7 (seven) days running from that due date. Once that period has expired without payment in full, Fleequid may, at its discretion, nevertheless accept late payment or proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale in accordance with Art. 12.7, with the effects referred to in Arts. 12.8 and 12.9.
translations.u202: Where Fleequid proceeds with the Cancellation of the Sale on account of delay in paying, or failure to pay, the Advance Payment or the balance, in each case attributable to the Buyer pursuant to Art. 13.5, the Advance Payment actually paid can no longer be applied to the price and is definitively converted into a further, independent penalty, which is retained by Fleequid. The conversion does not operate where the Cancellation of the Sale follows breaches by the Buyer other than those governed by Art. 13.5, such as, by way of example, failure to collect the Vehicle after payment in full. The said penalty may be cumulated, within the limits permitted by law, with the daily penalty accrued pursuant to Art. 13.5, with the Commissions payable by the Buyer and with the further penalties, Fees and amounts due pursuant to Art. 12.9, it being understood that this penalty is counted for the purposes of reaching the financial floor provided for in Art. 12.9, which operates exclusively for any difference necessary to reach the relevant threshold. Where the Advance Payment has not been paid or has been paid only in part, the conversion into a penalty operates exclusively up to the amount actually paid, without prejudice to all further amounts owed by the Buyer as a result of the breach and of the Cancellation of the Sale. Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage, solely for the part in excess, remains unaffected.
translations.u203: Where, for reasons attributable to the Seller, the transaction cannot be completed or the Vehicle cannot be transferred or delivered as agreed, Fleequid may proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale, without prejudice to any further remedy provided for in these General Terms and Conditions. In such case the Advance Payment actually paid is returned in full to the Buyer in accordance with Art. 15, and the consequences provided for in the event of breach by the Buyer shall not apply to the Buyer. Cancellation of the Sale for reasons attributable to the Seller neither prejudices nor absorbs the consequences of the Seller's breach: the Seller shall be subject, in so far as compatible, to the same penalties, Fees, obligations to pay compensation and further consequences provided for in these General Terms and Conditions for breach by the Seller in transactions in which the Vehicle does not temporarily remain in use by the Seller, including those provided for in Arts. 8.11, 16.9 and 17.8 in the event of failure to transfer ownership, failure to deliver or unavailability of the Vehicle, without prejudice to any provisions of the Special Sale Terms and Conditions for the specific transaction. Any consequences provided for in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions in relation to exceeding the permitted mileage, deterioration of the Vehicle, delay in making it available or releasing it and the other obligations specific to this arrangement are in addition, where expressly provided and within the limits permitted by law, to the remedies applicable pursuant to the preceding sentence. Where the Seller significantly affects the value, characteristics or availability of the Vehicle, Fleequid may in any event proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale, return to the Buyer the amounts due to the Buyer pursuant to Art. 15 and retain in full the remedies available to it against the Seller.
translations.u204: Save as expressly derogated from by this article or by the Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the specific transaction, all the provisions of these General Terms and Conditions relating to the applicable Sales Model and to the chosen method of performance remain applicable in full, including those concerning invoicing, the time limits for the issue, transmission, correction or reissue of the relevant documents, any penalties connected with delay, payment of the sums due to the Seller, transfer of ownership, the necessary documentation, and delivery and collection of the Vehicle. The fact that the Vehicle temporarily remains in use by the Seller and the particular structure of payment provided for in this article do not, in themselves, entail any derogation from the other obligations of the Seller or of the Buyer, unless the derogation results expressly from the applicable Special Sale Terms and Conditions.
translations.u205: Without prejudice to Art. 8.13, for the entire period during which the Vehicle temporarily remains in use by, or otherwise at the disposal of, the Seller pursuant to this article, all risks, liabilities and costs connected with the custody, use, circulation, preservation and availability of the Vehicle remain with the Seller, save for whatever is mandatorily attributable to Fleequid or to the Buyer. The Seller therefore undertakes to indemnify and hold harmless Fleequid and the Buyer, as well as the companies of the Fleequid group and their respective directors, employees, collaborators and agents, against any claim, demand, action, sanction, cost, expense, damage or liability arising, directly or indirectly, from the custody, use, circulation, preservation or availability of the Vehicle during that period, including those resulting from accidents, damage to persons or property, administrative or road traffic offences, absent or inadequate insurance cover, loss, theft, deterioration of or damage to the Vehicle, its unavailability, alteration of its condition or characteristics, exceeding of any limits on use or mileage agreed, as well as from claims made by third parties as a result of acts attributable to the Seller. This indemnity is in addition to that provided for in Art. 8.13 and neither excludes nor limits any mandatory obligations incumbent on Fleequid towards the Buyer by reason of the applicable Sales Model; in such cases Fleequid's right of recourse against the Seller for everything attributable to the Seller remains unaffected. The further rights of recourse, reimbursement and compensation available to Fleequid and to the Buyer under these General Terms and Conditions and under the law likewise remain unaffected, it being understood that this indemnity does not extend to consequences directly attributable to the wilful misconduct or gross negligence of the person seeking to rely on it.
translations.u207: The Cancellation of the Sale is the contractual mechanism by which Fleequid, in the cases provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, in the Specific Terms and Conditions or in the applicable Special Sale Terms and Conditions, determines that the transaction shall not be performed or shall cease to be performed, in whole or in respect of one or more Vehicles only. The Cancellation of the Sale does not necessarily coincide with annulment of the contract on grounds of invalidity or with termination for breach: the actual legal basis depends on the individual circumstances giving rise to it. Where the Cancellation follows a breach covered by an express termination clause pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions, it operates as termination of the Contract pursuant to Art. 1456 of the Italian Civil Code and produces the effects thereof. In all other cases the Cancellation produces the effects provided for in the provision that provides for it and, in so far as not otherwise regulated, those provided for in this article and in Art. 15.
translations.u208: The conditions for and the grounds of the Cancellation of the Sale are governed by the provisions regulating the relevant circumstances and, in particular: by Art. 9.7, in the event of manifest clerical error; by Art. 12.7 in the event of delay in payment or failure to pay attributable to the Buyer; by Art. 13.7, for reasons attributable to the Seller, in transactions with the Vehicle temporarily in use by the Seller; by Arts. 16.7 and 16.9 in the event of failure by the Buyer to collect the Vehicle and of failure to deliver attributable to the Seller; by Art. 16.14 in the event that the Buyer does not meet the requirements; by Arts. 17.6, 17.8, 17.14 and 18.7 in the cases provided for therein; by Art. 20.8 as the outcome of the handling of a complaint; by Art. 4.9 in the event that the transaction subsequently becomes incompatible with the applicable legislation; as well as by Art. 14.4 below in the event of reduction of the subject matter of the sale. The further cases provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, in the Specific Terms and Conditions or in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions applicable to the specific transaction remain unaffected, and the provisions of this article may not be interpreted as limiting the rights conferred on Fleequid.
translations.u209: The Cancellation of the Sale is ordered by means of a unilateral declaration by Fleequid, notified in writing to the persons concerned in the manner provided for in Art. 24, and takes effect from the time of the notification, unless the provision applicable to the specific circumstances provides otherwise. Until that time the transaction is not automatically dissolved and the obligations of the Parties remain in force. The exercise of the right of Cancellation does not require a judicial determination of the relevant conditions and does not prejudice the further remedies available to Fleequid.
translations.u210: The transaction and the relevant Contract may relate to one or more Vehicles, including with partial transfer thereof. Where the transaction concerns more than one Vehicle, until the transfer and collection of the Vehicles concerned have been completed Fleequid reserves the right, at its discretion and for operational, technical or administrative reasons or for reasons otherwise connected with the proper performance of the transaction, to: a) cancel the sale in its entirety; b) cancel the sale in respect of one or more Vehicles only; or c) reduce the number of Vehicles forming the subject matter of the sale. This right constitutes an essential element of the functioning of the Marketplace and of the organisation of the transactions managed by Fleequid and may be exercised irrespective of whether the relevant causes are attributable to the Seller, to the Buyer, to third parties or, within the limits permitted by law, to Fleequid itself. It may be exercised, by way of example, in the event of supervening unavailability, loss, destruction of or damage to one or more Vehicles, technical, logistical, administrative or regulatory impediments, operational requirements relating to the management of the Vehicle, failure to collect within the time limits provided for, as well as in the event of breach of these General Terms and Conditions by the Seller or by the Buyer.
translations.u211: The reduction of the subject matter of the sale produces the effects of a partial termination of the Contract in respect of the Vehicles concerned only. The Contract remains valid and effective for the Vehicles not subject to cancellation and the Total Amount Due is redetermined accordingly. Where separate prices or values have been identified for the individual Vehicles for the purposes of the specific transaction, the redetermination is carried out by excluding the amounts referable to the Vehicles subject to cancellation. Where, on the other hand, a single overall price has been established without indication of the price referable to each Vehicle, the price is redetermined in proportion to the number of Vehicles for which the sale remains effective, unless the Special Sale Terms and Conditions or the agreements applicable to the specific transaction provide for a different allocation criterion. The Commissions, the Fees and the further amounts linked to the Vehicles for which the sale remains effective are redetermined accordingly, on the basis of the same criteria and in so far as applicable. In the Commission Sale the reduction entails the corresponding redetermination of the amounts due to the Seller with reference only to the Vehicles actually transferred, applying, in the absence of a separate valuation of the individual Vehicles, the same proportional criterion. In Dealer Sales with a purchase linked to the sale to a specific Buyer, the reduction entails, to the extent that the effects of the purchase pursuant to Arts. 8.8 and 18.2 have not yet been produced, the corresponding reduction of the Vehicles that Fleequid is required to purchase from the Seller and of the relevant Purchase Price, applying the criteria indicated above. The reduction of the subsequent sale to the Buyer does not, however, affect the Purchase Price or the other effects of a purchase for stock already concluded and effective between the Seller and Fleequid, unless otherwise agreed between the relevant Parties. In transactions relating to more than one Vehicle, the criteria provided for in this paragraph also apply to the determination of the bases of calculation of the penalties provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, including the Commissions, actual or notional, taken as a parameter: the basis consists of the value individually attributed to the individual Vehicle, where available, or, failing that, of the share of the overall value referable to it according to the proportional criterion indicated above, and the penalty is calculated exclusively with reference to the Vehicles affected by the breach or by the Cancellation.
translations.u212: The Buyer and the Seller expressly acknowledge and accept Fleequid's right to proceed with the Cancellation of the Sale and with the reduction of its subject matter in the cases provided for in this article and may not object to the continuation of the transaction in respect of the Vehicles for which the sale remains effective. Save as mandatorily provided for by law and save in cases of wilful misconduct or gross negligence on the part of Fleequid, the Buyer and the Seller are not entitled to any indemnity or compensation from Fleequid by reason of the mere fact of the Cancellation, of the partial cancellation or of the reduction of the subject matter of the sale, the only obligation remaining, to the extent of their respective entitlements, being the restitution of any sums paid with reference to the Vehicles subject to cancellation, in accordance with Art. 15. The further consequences provided for in these General Terms and Conditions remain unaffected where the Cancellation or the reduction is the consequence of a breach attributable to the Seller or to the Buyer.
translations.u213: In the Commission Sale the Commissions due to Fleequid remain payable with reference to the Vehicles for which the sale remains effective and is successfully completed pursuant to Art. 12.4. With reference to the Vehicles subject to Cancellation or reduction, the Commissions do not accrue, unless they have already validly accrued before the Cancellation in accordance with Art. 12.4. Where the Cancellation is the consequence of a breach attributable to the Buyer, the Commissions payable by the Buyer remain due in any event and the penalties, the Fees and the further amounts provided for in Arts. 12.8 and 12.9 shall apply. Where the Cancellation is the consequence of a breach attributable to the Seller, the Commissions payable by the Seller that have not yet accrued do not become due as consideration for the transaction, without prejudice to the penalties and the further amounts provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, even where determined by taking the Commissions that would have been due as a notional parameter of calculation, and to Fleequid's right to compensation for any further damage. Where the Cancellation is not attributable to the Buyer, the Commissions payable by the Buyer do not remain definitively due and, if already paid, are returned pursuant to Art. 15, unless otherwise expressly provided by a special provision of these General Terms and Conditions. In Dealer Sales the Commissions specific to the Commission Sale do not apply, without prejudice to the penalties, the Fees and any further amounts due.
translations.u214: The common restitutionary and financial effects of the Cancellation of the Sale and of the reduction of its subject matter are governed by Art. 15. Any special effects provided for in respect of individual circumstances remain governed by the relevant provisions and prevail, as regards the matters specifically regulated by them, over the general rules.
translations.u216: The obligation to return the sums paid by the Buyer arises: a) in the event of Cancellation of the Sale or of reduction of its subject matter pursuant to Art. 14, for the sums referable to the Vehicles for which the sale is not performed; b) in the event of Cancellation of the Sale ordered in the context of the handling of a complaint pursuant to Art. 20.8, within the limits provided for therein; c) in the event that the transaction is not completed for reasons attributable to the Seller, with reference to the Advance Payment and to any further sums paid by the Buyer that must be returned to the Buyer pursuant to Art. 13.7 and the other applicable provisions; d) in the event of Cancellation of the Sale for breach by the Buyer, limited to any excess of the sums already paid by the Buyer over the amounts that Fleequid or the other persons entitled may lawfully retain or apply pursuant to Art. 12.9; e) in the further cases in which these General Terms and Conditions, the Specific Terms and Conditions or the Special Sale Terms and Conditions provide for the return, in whole or in part, of sums paid by the Buyer. The separate rules on the Security Deposit provided for in Art. 6.3 and those on the Advance Payment provided for in Art. 13 remain unaffected.
translations.u217: The sums due pursuant to this article are returned within 15 (fifteen) days from the occurrence of the relevant condition or, if later, from the final determination of the sums to be returned, without payment of interest, save in the case of delay in the return beyond the said time limit. Where, for the purposes of determining the amount to be returned, it is necessary first to quantify or apply Commissions, penalties, interest, Fees, expenses or further sums due, the time limit runs from the time at which such determination has been completed.
translations.u218: The person required to return the sums paid by the Buyer is identified according to the person who actually received them and the applicable Sales Model. In the Commission Sale performed by means of Resale and in Dealer Sales, Fleequid returns the sums actually received by it from the Buyer, within the limits of what is due pursuant to these General Terms and Conditions. Where Fleequid has acted as a Pure Intermediary, the Seller is required to return the price of the Vehicle and the further sums directly received by it, while Fleequid returns the Commissions, the Fees and the further amounts directly received by it, each within the limits of the sums actually received and which must be returned. The different provisions laid down on the handling of complaints remain unaffected, as does Fleequid's right, where it advances to the Buyer sums the return of which is attributable to the Seller, to recover them in full from the Seller, together with any costs and the further amounts due.
translations.u219: Where payment has been made, in whole or in part, by a Financier, the sums to be returned are paid to the Financier within the limits of the amount actually paid by it, save as otherwise provided for in the applicable Specific Terms and Conditions or in joint written instructions from the Buyer and the Financier. Where part of the sums has been paid directly by the Buyer, the relevant return is made to the Buyer, according to the respective origin of the payments. It is understood that, where under the Specific Terms and Conditions the Financier has directly assumed the status of Buyer, the rights to restitution belong to the Financier.

translations.u231: Following the notification that the Vehicle has been made available for delivery, the Buyer shall collect it within 10 (ten) days, in the manner, at the place and at the times indicated by Fleequid, save where a different time limit is expressly communicated in writing or provided for in the Special Sale Terms and Conditions. Mere delay in making the Vehicle available or in delivering it, where not followed by the Cancellation of the Sale, does not give rise to the penalties provided for in the two preceding sentences, without prejudice to compensation for any damage and to the further remedies provided for in these General Terms and Conditions, as well as to the penalty referred to in Art. 16.3 where the relevant conditions are independently met.
